title: Euan's QOL Pack
description: A vanilla-friendly quality of life pack packed with small fixes and helpful tweaks, no added content, just smarter, smoother gameplay.
body:
![Euan's QOL Pack Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/542da89fe81ff3ac37ecc16e4fe05b98056006cd.png)_Small tweaks. Big difference._

My very own collection of quality-of-life enhancements built to refine your Minecraft experience without changing its core. This pack makes the game smarter and more intuitive—from better inventory handling and smart keybinds, to removing annoyances like chat limits, trample damage, or weird movement behavior. It’s all about making vanilla Minecraft just feel better to play.

- ✅ Smoother controls & movement tweaks  
- ✅ Better chat, placement, and trading tools  
- ✅ No new blocks or gameplay mechanics  
- ✅ Keeps the vanilla experience intact

> ⚠️**Server Notice:** Certain mods included (like *Accessible Step*, *Accurate Block Placement Reborn*, *AutoTotem*, *Bridging Mod*, *JJElytraSwap*, *Jump Over Fences*, *Librarian Trade Finder*) may not be allowed on some multiplayer servers and could be considered unfair or cheating. Use responsibly and check server rules before joining.
